TELEGRAM.title: Telegram bot
TELEGRAM.description: The support bot that notifies staff listed under Bot notifications. With a username set, students connect to it from their personal page for lesson reminders, homework and payment notices. Every Sunday evening those chats can also get a weekly report on attendance, grades, homework, coins and the balance.

AMOCRM.inboundHint: In amoCRM open Settings → Integrations → Webhooks, add the address above with your webhook secret in place of the dots and tick “Lead added”. Each such lead lands in the column chosen here under the source named here and is not pushed back to amoCRM.

FACE_ID.title: FaceID
FACE_ID.description: Terminals post staff check-ins to the webhook; they feed the staff attendance report.
FACE_ID.payloadHint: Payload: deviceId, phone (+998…), at (ISO time), kind IN or OUT.

VIDEO.title: Video lessons
VIDEO.description: Teachers start a call from the group page and students join from their personal link. Video goes directly between browsers; Kampus only connects them.

fields.turnSecret: TURN shared secret (instead of username and password)

VIDEO.hint: Works without setup using free public STUN servers. Some mobile and office networks block direct calls; for those, add a TURN relay (for example Cloudflare Calls TURN, Metered or your own coturn).
VIDEO.retentionHint: Recordings older than this are deleted every night, together with their video file, to keep the server's disk from filling up. 0 keeps them forever.

PAYME.title: Payme
PAYME.description: Students pay their course fee from their personal link; Payme confirms through the webhook and the payment appears in Kampus by itself.
PAYME.hint: In Payme Business, create a cashbox with the account field “order_id”, set this webhook as the endpoint URL and copy the key here. Use https://checkout.test.paycom.uz and the test key to try it first.

CLICK.title: Click
CLICK.description: Students pay their course fee from their personal link; Click confirms through prepare and complete calls to the webhook.
CLICK.hint: In the Click merchant cabinet, set this webhook as both the prepare and the complete URL.

excel.importHint: Download the template, fill one row per record and upload the file. The first row is the header.
excel.preview: Preview: {count} rows would be imported and {skipped} skipped. Nothing has been written yet.
excel.noHeader: The header row was not recognised, so the template's column order was assumed.

hints.rooms: One row per room: name, seats (10 when empty) and, if needed, the branch. Rooms that already exist are skipped.
hints.courses: One row per course: name, monthly price, length in months (1 when empty), description and, if needed, the branch. Existing names are skipped.
hints.staff: One row per person: full name, phone, roles (Teacher, Cashier, Admin…, comma-separated), branches, gender, dates and a password. Leave the password empty and Kampus makes a temporary one and shows it once after the import.
hints.groups: One row per group: name, course, teacher (name or phone), days (Mon, Wed, Fri or odd/even), start and end time, room, start date, end date and status. Course, teacher and room must already exist.
hints.parents: One row per parent: the student (Kampus ID, phone or exact name), the parent's name and phone.
